title: Deleting notes without even warning
body:
Very bad experience with the Notes app. An extremely important study note disappeared completely without me deleting it. It is not in Recently Deleted, not showing in search, not on iCloud, and there is no clear way to recover it.

An app used for important notes and studying should never lose user data like this, especially without warning or recovery options. This is unacceptable and very stressful. The app is unreliable if a full note can suddenly disappear as if it never existed.

title: DONT EVER USE THIS FOR STUDYING
body:
The notes app takes up unnecessary storage in the iPad which causes it to overheat and slow down. It frequently crashes and the storage used skyrockets. If the file size is more than 100mb it take around 6 minutes to load. Some textbooks I used went up to 4 GB before everything got deleted. Use any other software but not this. 
UPDATE: this app has gotten much much much much WORSE!!!. I did 5 hours of annnotations and it crashed and got deleted. Apple should really be fixing problems in apps rather the. Launching iPhones with more and more cameras 

I repeat:
DO NOT USE THIS APP: YOU WILL REGRET IT
